<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def ts(fr):
    s=fr.segmentation; out=['?']*5
    bars={20:0,25:1,30:2,35:3,40:4}; stems={21:0,26:1,31:2,36:3,41:4}
    for n in s['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']==3 and n['boundary'][0][0]>=42:
            c=n['boundary'][0][1]; part='bar' if n['boundary'][0][0]==42 else 'stem'
            ii=bars.get(c) if part=='bar' else stems.get(c)
            if ii is not None: out[ii]=n['color']
    return ''.join(out)
def sq(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']<15:
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b))
    return None
print("start T=",ts(current_frame),"sq=",sq(current_frame))
seq=[(45,21),(45,31),(45,21),(45,31)]
for k,(r,c) in enumerate(seq):
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    print(f"click{k+1}({r},{c}) -> T={ts(current_frame)} sq={sq(current_frame)} lvl={current_frame.level} done={last_action_result.get('done')} lc={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
